pages.text: Infinity comes in kinds. The $(item)Cantor Key$() opens a dimension built in strata - each layer of islands higher and sparser than the last - where the ordinals and cardinals are mined.

$(item)Ordinal Shards$() become $(item)Omega$(), $(item)Epsilon-Naught$() and $(item)Omega-One$() in the $(item)Ordinal Recursor$(); $(item)Cardinal Shards$() become $(item)Aleph-One$() and the $(item)Inaccessible Cardinal$() that Absolute Infinity now needs - a size no lesser infinity can ever reach.

Higher dimensions live here too: $(item)Hypersphere Fragments$() make the $(item)Hopf Fibration$(), the $(item)Penteract$() and the $(item)E8 Lattice$(). Look for $(thing)Hilbert's Hotel$(), $(thing)Ordinal Spires$(), $(thing)Tesseract Frames$() and $(thing)Hopf Rings$().

Natives: $(thing)Hilbert Bellhops$() (harmless; they carry the hotel's keys), $(thing)Hypercube Drifters$() (harmless) and $(thing)Ordinal Hounds$(), whose bites stack $(thing)Infinite Regress$() - every hit after makes you take more. Run early.
Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place. Use again to return.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
The first number after all of the counting numbers.$(br2)Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().
A piece of the order in which infinities come.$(br2)Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().
Omega to the omega to the omega... forever. And still countable.$(br2)Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().
The first ordinal that cannot be counted.$(br2)Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Omega$(): Absolute Notes II, Cardinal Shard, Epsilon-Naught$(li)$(item)Ordinal Shard$(): Absolute Notes III, Epsilon-Naught, Omega, Ordinal Recursor$(li)$(item)Epsilon-Naught$(): Absolute Notes III, Absolute Singularity, Mathematics Singularity, Omega-One$(li)$(item)Omega-One$(): Absolute Notes I, Aleph-One, Continuum Shard
$(thing)Hilbert Bellhop$(). Lives in: Transfinite Strata.$(br)Drops: Hilbert's Hotel Key, Ordinal Shard.
$(thing)Hypercube Drifter$(). Lives in: Transfinite Strata.$(br)Drops: Hypersphere Fragment, Tesseract Core.
$(thing)Ordinal Hound$(). Lives in: Transfinite Strata.$(br)Drops: Ordinal Shard, Cardinal Shard.

$(thing)Dimension data: The Transfinite Hierarchy$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 7 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Well-Ordering Charm$() - with it, Infinite Regress I and hunger.
